movelist.name: Dream Eater
movelist.effect: Dream Eater can only target Sleeping Pokémon or Trainers. After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target. Dream Eater does not wake up sleeping targets.

movelist.name: Freezing Glare
movelist.effect: Freezing Glare Freezes the target on a 19+. Once per Scene, Freezing Glare may instead be used as an Ice-Type Move.

movelist.name: Recover
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value.

movelist.name: Psycho Cut
movelist.effect: Psycho Cut is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Tailwind
movelist.effect: For the remainder of the encounter, all allied trainers and Pokémon gain +5 to their Initiative. Multiple instances of Tailwind cannot stack.

movelist.name: Ancient Power
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.effect: The user’s Accuracy cannot be lowered, their attacks cannot have Accuracy Penalties (such as from Illuminate), the user is immune to the Blind condition (but not Total Blindness), and the user ignores any Evasion not directly derived from Stats (such as from the Instinct Ability, or from moves like Minimize).

abilities.name: Competitive
abilities.effect: Whenever the user has its Combat Stages lowered, by something other than its own Moves or Abilities, the user’s Special Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Beam Cannon
abilities.effect: The Effect Range and Critical Hit Range of the user’s Ranged, 1-Target Moves are increased by 3.
